process_area.title: Indirect Tax (VAT & Percentage Tax) & BIR E-Invoicing

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, GL Accountant, AP/AR, Tax Accountant
fields.Trigger: Monthly VAT close-and-file cycle (2550M statutory deadline: 20th of following month, or the 25th for later eFPS groups)
fields.Volume: 5 returns/month; ~PHP 5.19B monthly revenue at 12% output VAT

workflows.name: VAT Output/Input Ledger Reconciliation & Monthly Form 2550M Preparation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates VAT treatment on every taxable line" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Tax Manager computes net VAT payable/refundable" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "prepares BIR Form 2550M with supporting schedules" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-214 (ensure BIR tax compliance & filing integrity.)
- operational: automated tax determination rules and monthly reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Mis-classified VAT-exempt sales (PWD/SC, housing, education) trigger assessment; mitigated by automated tax determination rules and monthly reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - ERP Financials tax register & VAT control accounts; BIR eFPS; e-Invoicing (EIS) log

steps.activity: GL Accountant reconciles VAT output (sales) vs. input (purchases) ledgers from ERP tax registers per entity; validates VAT treatment on every taxable line; flags mixed-tender and exempt sales
Tax Manager computes net VAT payable/refundable; reconciles to GL VAT control accounts; investigates variances > PHP 50K; books adjusting journal entries
Tax Accountant prepares BIR Form 2550M with supporting schedules; routes for CFO sign-off; archives computation workpapers for 10-year BIR retention

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, Tax Accountant, External Tax Advisor

workflows.name: Quarterly VAT Return (2550Q) & Transitional Input Tax Processing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates against GL quarterly trial balance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-createof "Tax Manager processes transitional input VAT on capital" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents positions taken for future audit defensibility" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-466 (ensure controlled execution — Indirect Tax (VAT & Percentage Tax) & BIR E-Invoicing (PA-79.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reporting risk**: TRAIN capital-goods phase-out errors (post-2021 acquisitions claimed on spread instead of fully creditable, or grandfathered pre-2022 60-month balances claimed in full — per RMC 21-2022); mitigated by advisor review and rule-versioning
System Touchpoints: - ERP Financials quarterly tax close workspace; BIR eFPS

steps.activity: Tax Accountant consolidates three monthly 2550M filings into quarterly summary; reconciles cumulative output/input VAT; validates against GL quarterly trial balance

Tax Manager processes transitional input VAT on capital asset acquisitions (fully creditable in the acquisition month since 1 Jan 2022 per the TRAIN phase-out; residual 60-month schedules only for grandfathered pre-2022 assets per RMC 21-2022); coordinates with external advisor on contentious items
Tax Manager files 2550Q via eFPS; settles any quarterly true-up; documents positions taken for future audit defensibility

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs into BIR eFPS, selects return type and tax period, uploads/generated data" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based authorization of "Authorized Agent Bank" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Tax Accountant attaches proof of filing and payment to" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-214 (ensure BIR tax compliance & filing integrity.)
- operational: filing 3+ days early and maintaining offline computation backups
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: eFPS downtime near deadlines; mitigated by filing 3+ days early and maintaining offline computation backups
System Touchpoints: - BIR eFPS portal; treasury banking platform; ERP document archive; tax calendar workflow

steps.activity: Tax Accountant logs into BIR eFPS, selects return type and tax period, uploads/generated data; validates auto-computed fields vs. ERP workpapers before submission
Treasury initiates e-Payment via Authorized Agent Bank (AAB) PESONet/InstaPay or revenue collection officer; captures payment confirmation/reference number
Tax Accountant attaches proof of filing and payment to ERP tax document repository; updates tax calendar tracker; flags any rejection for re-filing before deadline

fields.Participants: Tax Tech Lead, IT Integration, POS Team, Tax Manager

workflows.name: BIR EIS E-Invoicing Transmission & Daily Sales Report Sync

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors acknowledgment receipts per location" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Tax Tech Lead reconciles transmitted line count vs. ERP" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews monthly EIS transmission completeness report" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-214 (ensure BIR tax compliance & filing integrity.)
- operational: daily reconciliation and SLA monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Failed/unreconciled EIS transmission invites penalty (PHP 1K–50K/return) and LO/permit risk; mitigated by daily reconciliation and SLA monitoring
System Touchpoints: - BIR EIS API gateway; POS-to-ERP event stream; ERP sales register; transmission log

steps.activity: IT Integration ensures daily Sales Data Transmission (Sales Report + e-Invoice JSON) from ERP/POS to BIR EIS via API; monitors acknowledgment receipts per location
Tax Tech Lead reconciles transmitted line count vs. ERP sales register daily; investigates missing/failed transmissions (offline POS recovery); triggers re-transmission
Tax Manager reviews monthly EIS transmission completeness report; escalates systemic integration failures to IT; maintains compliance attestation for BIR inspection

fields.Participants: Tax Accountant, AR, Trade Sales, Tax Manager
fields.Trigger: Sale to VAT-exempt customer or entity with PEZA/BOI/housing incentive

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Trade Sales obtains customer exemption certificate" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates exemption currency and scope" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documentation support for monthly 2550M exemption schedule" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-214 (ensure BIR tax compliance & filing integrity.)
- operational: annual renewal tracking and pre-sale validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit risk**: Expired/incomplete exemption documents disallow VAT-zero-rating; mitigated by annual renewal tracking and pre-sale validation
System Touchpoints: - ERP customer/item tax determination; document archive; BIR Tax Credit Certificate (TCC) module
Time Estimate: - 30–60 min per account setup; ongoing monitoring

steps.activity: Trade Sales obtains customer exemption certificate (PEZA/BOI, DepEd/CHED, PAG-IBIG-accredited housing, NGO BIR rulings) at account setup; AR stores in customer master
Tax Accountant validates exemption currency and scope; configures VAT-exempt/zero-rated treatment in ERP customer/item tax code; audits renewal calendar annually
Tax Accountant compiles exemption documentation support for monthly 2550M exemption schedule; defends zero-rated input VAT refund claims with BIR

fields.Participants: Tax Accountant, Fixed Asset Accountant, Tax Manager
fields.Trigger: Acquisition of capital goods > PHP 1M per BIR rules (Sec. 110(A)(2) NIRC; input VAT fully creditable since 1 Jan 2022 (the 60-month spread repealed by CREATE/RA 11534 per RR 7-2021; TRAIN-era RR 13-2018 set the sunset) — spread amortization applies only to grandfathered pre-2022 assets)
fields.Volume: ~PHP 700M–1B annual capex (store builds alone run PHP 400–900M per W1648); ~PHP 84–120M input VAT pool

workflows.name: Capital Goods Input VAT — Full-Credit Regime & Grandfathered 60-Month Amortization Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Accountant flags capital goods acquisitions > PHP 1M threshold at capitalization" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scheduleof "ERP tax register" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles amortization register to fixed asset subledger annually" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-466 (ensure controlled execution — Indirect Tax (VAT & Percentage Tax) & BIR E-Invoicing (PA-79.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reporting risk**: Mis-tracking disposal acceleration underclaims/overclaims VAT; mitigated by FA-to-tax register reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - ERP Fixed Asset & input VAT amortization register; tax ledger
Time Estimate: - 2–4 hours per qualifying asset setup; monthly run

steps.activity: Fixed Asset Accountant flags capital goods acquisitions > PHP 1M threshold at capitalization; captures input VAT component and in-service date

Tax Accountant claims the full input VAT in the acquisition month (post-2021 regime); maintains residual 60-month amortization schedules in the ERP tax register for grandfathered pre-2022 assets, claiming the spread portion monthly on 2550M and tracking remaining balance per asset
Tax Manager reconciles amortization register to fixed asset subledger annually; accelerates remaining balance on asset disposal/retirement

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, Tax Accountant, Entity Controllers

workflows.name: Percentage Tax (2551Q) & Entities Below VAT Threshold Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor aggregate quarterly gross sales per entity against PHP 3M VAT threshold" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Tax Manager files 2551Q" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents VAT-vs-percentage-tax optimization decision annually" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-466 (ensure controlled execution — Indirect Tax (VAT & Percentage Tax) & BIR E-Invoicing (PA-79.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Late VAT registration when crossing threshold; mitigated by quarterly threshold dashboard
System Touchpoints: - ERP per-entity revenue register; BIR eFPS 2551Q; threshold monitoring dashboard

steps.activity: Entity Controllers monitor aggregate quarterly gross sales per entity against PHP 3M VAT threshold; flag entities approaching the threshold for VAT registration planning
Tax Manager files 2551Q (3% percentage tax) for any non-VAT-registered entity; coordinates voluntary VAT registration election where input VAT recovery is favorable
Tax Manager documents VAT-vs-percentage-tax optimization decision annually; reviews entity structure for tax efficiency under CREATE and CREATE More

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, IT, Store Ops, Legal
fields.Trigger: New POS rollout, system upgrade, or annual BIR audit

workflows.name: POS BIR-Registered Accreditation, CAS Registration & Compliance Audit

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Tax Manager maintains BIR Computerized Accounting System" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "logs any deviation through change-control re-accreditation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "inspection of CAS" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-214 (ensure BIR tax compliance & filing integrity.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Unaccredited POS/upgrade voids invoice validity; mitigated by permit-master gating of go-lives
System Touchpoints: - POS permit master; BIR CAS/LOI register; change-control workflow
Time Estimate: - 4–8 hours per permit event; 1–2 weeks per BIR audit

steps.activity: Tax Manager maintains BIR Computerized Accounting System (CAS)/POS permit inventory per location; processes new/refresh permits (BIR Form 1907) for every terminal swap or software upgrade
IT ensures POS firmware/software matches BIR-accredited configuration (PTU); logs any deviation through change-control re-accreditation
Legal/Tax Manager supports BIR annual LOI inspection of CAS; demonstrates invoice numbering, TIN, sequential integrity, and tamper-evident logs across sample locations
